subject: Helpers for Differential Gene Expression using R workshop

messages.author: 2f78e326d6f095da
messages.subject: Helpers for Differential Gene Expression using R workshop
parts:
Hi D-RUG,

As I announced a few weeks ago, the DIB lab is putting on a Differential Gene Expression workshop using R this Wednesday, April 27 from 9:15 am - 12:15 pm. The informational page is here: http://dib-training.readthedocs.org/en/pub/2016-04-27-diff-exp-br.html 

It would be really great if we could get a few helpers for this event! You need familiarity with R and RStudio to be a helper, not the subject material specifically. And, this would be a great way to get familiarity with Differential Gene Expression if that's of interest to you. The instructor is teaching remotely, so her R expertise will not be available for any problems that arise.

If you are interested in being a helper or have any questions about it, send me an email at jessic...@gmail.com. There will be free coffee!
